name: Dimitri Volkov
bio:
Dimitri's career began in the Soviet automotive industry, where he honed his skills in supply chain management and quality control. The collapse of the USSR led him to seek opportunities elsewhere, and his passion for motorsport drew him to the West. He started as a junior mechanic for a small rally team, quickly demonstrating his organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail.

At Blau Motorsport, Dimitri ensures the smooth transportation and maintenance of equipment, from spare parts to the team's hospitality setup. He believes in proactive problem-solving and clear communication, striving to anticipate potential logistical bottlenecks before they impact the team's performance. His experience with both the practical and administrative sides of motorsport gives him a unique perspective, making him an invaluable asset to the team.

While some might see logistics as a purely functional role, Dimitri views it as a critical component of competitive success. His dedication to precision and efficiency ensures that the team is always prepared, regardless of the challenges presented by each race weekend.

physical.description: Dimitri is a stout man with a serious demeanor and weathered face.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously documenting every detail.
Insists on using a traditional Russian abacus for quick calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on surfaces when deep in thought.
